owner: Dept E (Chief Statistician, triage 2026-11-08; draft for the Director, NOT registered)
hypothesis: A pre-registered hypothesis under test, not an edge claim. The daily CFD/futures halt (about 16:15 or 17:00 to 18:00 ET) and the weekend accumulate news with no price; the 18:00 ET reopen prints it through a thin book (Asian early flow, retail and prop accounts re-entering after their forced flatten), so a large first-10-minute repricing overshoots and partly reverts before the Tokyo open (candidates.md rank 46 IG C-12-18 Sunday reopen, absorbing IG C-3-07 weekday reopen; own idea, evidence score 0). Sign fixed in advance: FADE the reopen move.
rules: Clock: America/New_York via zoneinfo, applied to HistData bars whose ts is bar-open UTC (clock histdata_rule, D-019). Instruments i in U = {SPX (US500), NSX (US100), XAU (XAUUSD)}. Session days d = Sunday-Thursday evenings whose 18:00-18:10 ET bars exist (Sunday = weekend reopen; Mon-Thu = daily reopen); skip d if it is the evening of a US full holiday or the day before one (exchange_calendars XNYS), or if any of the 18:00..18:10 bars is missing. Reference price C_i(d) = CLOSE of the last bar of i with open time in [15:00, 17:00) ET on the previous trading day (Friday for Sunday evenings). Signal price S_i(d) = CLOSE of the 18:09 bar. Reopen move M_i(d) = ln(S_i(d)/C_i(d)). Scale s_i(d) = sqrt(EWMA, centre of mass 60, of M_i^2 over the instrument's prior eligible session days through d-1), at least 40 prior observations; Sunday and weekday moves share one scale. Trigger: |M_i(d)| > 1.5 * s_i(d). FTMO-day rule: trade only on dates where 18:11 ET is at or after 00:00 Europe/Prague (i.e. NY and Prague clocks 6 h apart; US/EU DST-mismatch weeks are skipped by construction so the hold never crosses the FTMO midnight). ENTRY at the OPEN of the 18:11 bar (one-bar delay after the signal), side = -sign(M_i(d)). EXIT at the OPEN of the 19:30 bar (fallback first existing bar 19:31..19:33; else the close of the last bar in 19:15..19:29, counted and reported). Each instrument trades independently (0-3 legs per evening). Trade P&L = w_i * side * ln(P_exit/P_entry) - costs. No stops, no targets, no pyramiding; flat by 19:33 ET. QA spans honoured: SPX/NSX spike-reversal prints (data/qa) are kept as delivered but any leg whose entry or exit bar is flagged a spike reversal in the QA list is dropped (counted); NSX/SPX 2017-02-17..2017-02-26 gap is simply absent.
parameters: reference = last bar before 17:00 ET of the prior trading day; signal 18:09 close; trigger |M| > 1.5 EWMA(com 60) RMS; entry 18:11 open; exit 19:30 open; universe US500 US100 XAUUSD; FTMO-day filter (aligned DST weeks only)
instruments: FTMO US500.cash, US100.cash, XAUUSD CFDs (tested on HistData 1m bid CFD quotes); futures-venue sensitivity MES/MNQ/MGC attached without a count
holding: about 79 minutes (18:11 -> 19:30 ET) on triggered evenings; about 25-35% of about 200 eligible evenings per instrument -> about 150-200 trades/yr across the three instruments
vol_scaler: Leg weight w_i = (0.10/sqrt(252)) / sigma_i, sigma_i = EWMA (centre of mass 60 eligible evenings) s.d. of the instrument's own 18:11->19:30 log return through d-1 (all eligible evenings, triggered or not; at least 40 observations); no cap/floor.
cost_model: 1x floors per briefs/00-common.md: US500 1.0 bp, US100 1.0 bp, XAUUSD 1.0 bp per side on notional at entry and exit, on top of the bid-to-bid return (HistData bid-only). No swap (entry after the FTMO 00:00 CE(S)T rollover by the FTMO-day rule, exit the same FTMO day). 2x run attached (2.0 bp per side). Because reopen spreads are wider than the RTH floor, a 3x run is printed for information (no decision). Futures sensitivity (no count): MES/MNQ 0.25 pt + $0.80, MGC 1 tick + $0.80 per side.
decision_rule: Gate v2 on the OOS window only, one read through qe.gateway.load(id,'oos') per dataset in one run: pass iff (1) one-sided t of the net-1x per-evening P&L (Newey-West and stationary bootstrap >= 430,000 day-level draws; the lower) >= 3.6807; (2) net-2x mean > 0 (criterion 3); (3) criteria 4 and 7 of PARAMETERS.md (years, concentration incl. share from Sunday evenings and from any one instrument, terciles of |M|/s, +-25% neighbours on the trigger multiple, entry/exit minutes and the EWMA centre of mass, one-bar delay) pass; (4) Red Team and re-implementation sign-off; (5) hold-out read on the *_holdout datasets in the restated one-sided tolerance form with h = decay_haircut. Anything else is 'refuted' or 'near-miss'; the result file prints criterion-4 power and the joint figure for its own OOS length. Sub-periods reported, not decisive: 2013-2018, 2019-2024 (SPX/NSX CFD halt moved to 16:14 ET from 2019, data/qa), Sunday vs weekday.
notes: Source: candidates.md rank 46 IG C-12-18 (absorbs IG C-3-07), research/triage-2026-11-08.md class A. EVIDENCE WINDOW: none (own idea, no displayed curve), so the OOS is not derivative. IS 2010-11..2012-12 (warm-up, tercile bounds, harness, QA); OOS 2013-01-01..2024-12-31 = 12.0 years: bar 1.06 annual Sharpe; criterion-4 power 0.94/1.00/1.00 at true Sharpe 1.5/2.0/2.4; at the triage's realistic decayed Sharpe 0.6 it is 0.055. Institutional change: SPX/NSX HistData daily halt 16:59/17:15 ET to 2018, 16:14 ET from 2019 (data/qa SPXUSD/NSXUSD) -> sub-period. Dropped from the scout design: the BTC-weekend sign filter (Binance data not in the manifest) and the 6E leg (FX datasets not yet re-landed with histdata_rule). Closed families: H0012/H0017 (09:30 gap fade, closed) is the nearest - different session, different crowd, no RTH open; D4 intraday rules across 19 CFDs did not test the 18:00 reopen window (to be confirmed by the Rules Keeper before registration; if D4 covered it, the row is withdrawn). Economics: scout 3-13 bp reversion on top days vs 2 bp CFD round trip -> 1-4x after the 0.7 haircut; it passes the 2x-RT screen only on the triggered days, and the 2x cost criterion bites. RED TEAM objection (strongest, N): CFD spreads at the 18:00 reopen are several times the RTH floor, so the bid-only HistData return with a 1 bp floor overstates the net; the 3x run is the honest read and the row cannot be certified unless gross >= about 3x a realistic reopen spread. Firm clauses: FTMO intraday CFD (00:00 CE(S)T reset; the FTMO-day rule keeps the hold inside one day; 5% daily loss path-wise); FTMO funded +-2 min news: no scheduled US release at 18:11 or 19:30 ET (Tokyo data at 18:50/19:30 ET in summer touches the exit: Red Team to check JP release times; if needed exit 19:25). Overnight-session futures version (MES/MNQ/MGC 18:11->19:30 inside one trading day) is the futures twin: one decision unit, cost sensitivity only. Family reopen-overshoot-fade holds 1 of 5 counts after this row. Honest prior P(edge) about 0.05; expected passes about 0.003.
